about.description: Intimidator Deep Sea Fishing Charters is a professional offshore fishing charter service operating out of Orange Beach Marina. They offer half-day, full-day, and overnight deep sea fishing trips targeting both reef species and big game fish. The operation is led by Captain Johnny Greene and features a 65x19 ft Sportfisherman vessel built specifically for extended offshore fishing charters. They serve Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, Fort Morgan, and Perdido Key.
about.elevator_pitch: Professional offshore deep sea fishing charters with a safety-first crew, modern equipment, and a clear game plan for reef fish and big game pelagics.
about.vibe: Professional, safety-focused, experienced crew with a focus on real fishing rather than casual tourist experiences.
about.reservations: Required. Book online through new booking system or call/text (251) 747-2872. No walk-ons accepted.
about.insider_tip: Text your date, group size, trip type (Day/Full/Overnight), and target fish to (251) 747-2872 for crew recommendations on best booking option.
